name: Camp Hawkeye
description_short: Small, gender-inclusive overnight camp for ages 7-17 in Charlestown, NH, with sessions of 2, 4, 6 or 8 weeks. Tuition covers everything: program materials, out-of-camp hikes and trips, overnights, laundry, food and housing.
refund_policy_summary: You must cancel in writing to Jess@camphawkeye.com. Before January 1, all tuition is refunded, including the deposit. After January 1, the deposit is not refunded. After April 1, half of the tuition is not refunded. After June 1, none of the tuition is refunded.
swim_waterfront_notes: A 2,600 square foot pool and the stream-fed Lily Pond, with a rope swing. Daily recreational and instructional swim periods; certified lifeguards oversee all waterfront activities.

warnings: The page lists a 'Mid Summer Session' at $6,000 but gives no dates for it.
Early registration payment terms conflict: one part says '50% of the tuition is due by January15', another says '1/2 of the remaining tuition is due' on January 15.
Early registration deadline is stated both as 'before November 1' and 'closes October 31st'. It is still open as of today (2026-10-13).
Discounts: the sibling discount (10%) and early registration discount ($250) apply only to sessions of 4 weeks or longer. There are no discounts for 2-week sessions.
Footer copyright says 2022, but the page content is for the 2027 season.
The camp lists a winter office address at 2304 Cherry Lane, Arden, DE 19810. The NH address is the summer camp location.
Registration URL has a session-specific token removed.
